transmission.englishDescription: The act of delivering electricity, radio waves, information, etc., mechanically.

transmission.definitionKo: 주로 전기나 전파를 이용하여 전보나 전화, 라디오, 텔레비전 방송 등의 신호를 보냄. 또는 그런 일.
transmission.englishDescription: The act of sending signals of telegrams, telephone calls, radios, television broadcasts, etc., mainly through electricity or radio waves, or such an act.

transmission.definitionKo: 글이나 사진 등을 전류나 전파를 이용하여 다른 곳으로 보냄.
transmission.englishDescription: Sending text or pictures to another place using electric current or radio waves.

walking.definitionKo: 자전거나 자동차 등의 탈것을 타지 않고 걸어감.
walking.englishDescription: The act or action of walking rather than riding a vehicle such as a bicycle or car, etc.
The act of moving on foot.

walking.definitionKo: 이미 서서 걷고 있는 그대로의 걸음.
walking.englishDescription: The act of walking as if one was already going.
An act of walking a step; or such a step.
